lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Write a respectful paragraph response with credit, musical description and a protocol sentence.

FEEDBACK
Strong answer: Includes source credit, heard features, and a clear limit on what the student will not invent.

WATCH FOR
Dressing up or parodying songs. Respect means listening and crediting, not mock performance.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Complete a respectful response sheet after an approved listening experience. Ask an adult to check that no restricted content was guessed or copied.

Write a short reflection naming one artistic choice you changed and why. Movement or instrument work is optional, adult-supervised and can be described instead.

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Example: 'I listened to an approved recording shared for education. I heard layered voices and steady percussion. Source: [title]. I do not know restricted meanings, so I will not invent them. I can show respect by listening carefully and crediting artists.'

TRY FIRST
Write a respectful paragraph response with credit, musical description and a protocol sentence.

FEEDBACK
Strong answer: Includes source credit, heard features, and a clear limit on what the student will not invent.
teach_steps.explain:
A respectful response describes what you heard from an approved recording, acknowledges the peoples and source, avoids sacred speculation and reflects on what respectful listening means. If your school uses Acknowledgement of Country, you may include it appropriately without claiming cultural authority.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner make intentional visual, music, drama or dance choices and name their effect, rather than saying an artwork is simply “nice”. Keep every claim linked to an element or technique.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the elements, techniques or performance choices that carry the idea. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. For movement or instruments, use a clear space, ask an adult to be nearby and stop if anything feels unsafe. You may always describe a choice instead of performing it. One deliberate artistic choice with a named effect is more useful than a longer praise sentence.
teach_steps.notice: Dressing up or parodying songs. Respect means listening and crediting, not mock performance. Name the element or technique and its effect, not just decoration.
